intro.title: A warm welcome for Jewish travelers
intro.p1: Georgia is home to one of the oldest Jewish communities in the world, and Jewish life has been part of the country for many centuries. Georgians are known for their hospitality, and Israeli and Jewish visitors are a familiar sight in Tbilisi, Batumi and beyond.
intro.p2: In the larger cities you can find synagogues, Chabad houses and kosher food. Opening hours, prayer times and kashrut supervision can change, so it's always worth checking with the place directly before you go.
intro.p3: On this page you'll find a map of Jewish places added by our team, this week's Shabbat times for every city, a Jewish calendar with holidays and candle-lighting times, and emergency numbers to keep at hand.
